This page is the interactive version of the lesson notes (PDF). Each section
is one step of the seminar. It ends with a **Do it** task and one set of
questions. The full explanations, examples and exercises are in the notes.
You work alone.

## Key terms

{{< glossary copyright-holder work-for-hire licence attribution rights-clearance derivative-work trademark takedown-notice >}}

## 24.1 Who owns the assets of a game?

- **Employees:** the studio (**work for hire**).
- **Freelancers:** they keep it, unless a **written contract** says
  otherwise.
- **Libraries:** the creator; the studio gets a **licence**.
- **Fans:** fan art is a **derivative work** of the studio's characters.

![Who owns the assets?](images/ownership.png){width=94%}

::: {.callout-warning title="Watch out!"}
Payment alone does not move the copyright: the contract decides.
:::

::: {.callout-note title="Do it · Find the owners"}
Five assets of a game: who made each, and who owns it?
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 1 · Owners"}
Choose the owner.

::: {.match extra="the store|the players"}
Pasha the cat, drawn by Nour (employee)
:   Night Owl Games

a sound from a library, under a licence
:   the sound's creator

theme music by a freelancer, no contract
:   the freelancer

a fan's comic of Pasha
:   the fan, based on Night Owl's character
:::
:::

## 24.2 A rights check for every asset

- **1** Who made it? **2** Who owns it? **3** Which licence? **4** Does our
  use fit? **5** Credit written?
- A "no": **ask, replace or remove**.
- A **rights register:** one line per asset.

![A rights check.](images/rights-check.png){width=94%}

{{< sim file="sims/rights-check.html" poster="sims/rights-check.png" title="Rights Check: one asset at a time" height="620" >}}

::: {.callout-warning title="Watch out!"}
Check before the release, not after a takedown notice.
:::

::: {.callout-note title="Do it · Run the check"}
In **Rights Check**, check all six assets; write where each stops and the
fix.
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 2 · The check"}
Use Rights Check. Choose where the check stops.

::: {.match extra="question 0|question 6"}
the theme music (no contract)
:   question 2

the menu font ("free for personal use")
:   question 4

the rain sound (no credit line)
:   question 5

the poster photo (found by image search)
:   question 1
:::
:::

## 24.3 Inspired by, or copied?

- **Ideas, genres, mechanics:** free to use.
- **Expression** (drawings, sprites, music, text, code): protected.
- **Trademarks:** no lookalike names or logos.

![Inspired by, or copied?](images/inspired-copied.png){width=94%}

::: {.callout-warning title="Watch out!"}
There is no "30 % changed" rule.
:::

::: {.callout-note title="Do it · Inspired or copied?"}
Falling-block puzzle; a famous film's music; a hero in a blue cap in your
own style; a famous character's name in the title.
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 3 · Inspired or copied?"}
Choose the right answer.

::: {.match extra="free with a credit|a patent"}
a cat hero on rooftops
:   an idea, free to use

a traced sprite with new colours
:   copying

a logo like a big drink brand
:   a trademark problem

a rain level like in many games
:   inspiration
:::
:::

## 24.4 When something goes wrong

- **Takedown notice:** remove or replace, check the register, answer.
- **Fan works:** a fan content policy.
- **AI-made assets:** the tool's terms and the law decide; record the tool
  and the prompt.

::: {.callout-warning title="Watch out!"}
Never ignore a takedown notice.
:::

::: {.callout-note title="Do it · Your rights register"}
Make a register for six assets: asset, creator, owner, licence, use,
credit, status; at least one fix.
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 4 · Problems"}
Choose the first action.

::: {.match extra="ignore it|blame the player"}
a takedown notice for a photo
:   remove or replace the photo

a fan wants to sell prints of Pasha
:   follow the fan content policy

a poster made with an AI image tool
:   check the terms and record it

a theme without a contract
:   sign a written contract
:::
:::

## Game challenge: IP Desk {.challenge}

Work alone. Use every section of today.

Six problems: a **theme without a contract**, a **lookalike logo**, a
**traced sprite**, a **takedown notice**, a fan's **comics**, and an
**AI-made poster**.

{{< sim file="sims/ip-desk.html" poster="sims/ip-desk.png" title="IP Desk: six problems before the release" kind="game" height="480" >}}

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 5 · The desk"}
Choose the best action.

::: {.match extra="add a © sign|change two notes"}
theme music, paid, but no contract
:   get a written contract

a logo like a big drink brand
:   redesign the logo

a traced sprite
:   draw a new sprite

a photo with a takedown notice
:   remove it and check the register
:::
:::

## Summary {.summary}

- The owner decides: employees' work belongs to the studio; freelancers
  need contracts.
- Check every asset with five questions before the release.
- Ideas are free; expression and trademarks are protected.
- React fast to takedown notices; publish a fan content policy.
- Keep a rights register, and record how AI-made assets were made.
